# Felinid
Felinids are an offshoot of humans from decades of genetic modification of experimentation.
Their signature features are the fact they sport feline ears and tails, giving them exceptional senses of hearing and balance. Due to this, they take [color=#1e90ff]80% less damage from falling or high-speed impacts[/color]. In exchange they're more fragile, taking [color=#ffa500]15% more brute damage[/color].
Felinids are small, and can fit in duffelbags. They deal a mixture of [color=#ec3a3a]slash and piercing[/color] with their unarmed attacks thanks to their claws.
They inherently walk silently when not wearing any footwear, and are great thieves... much to their own chagrin.
## Ew, Hairballs
Felinids are also capable of eating live mice, which will allow them to cough up a disgusting hairball. Be careful when touching them, as they can [color=#ffa500]cause you to throwup when held.[/color] Felinids will use this to their advantage to gross out adversaries.
